findings.title: Hot and cold water available; adequate pressure.
findings.comment: The handwashing sinks in the two restrooms were observed to have no hot water available. The person-in-charge was informed. Ensure hot water is available at the handwashing sinks in the two restrooms at all times. The inspector will follow-up on April 10, 2026 to verify compliance.
findings.citation_text: 5-103.11(B) Capacity. (B) Hot water generation and distribution systems shall be sufficient to meet the peak hot water demands throughout the FOOD ESTABLISHMENT. [PF]

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean
findings.comment:
6-501.11: Inspector observed the sink in the men’s restroom is no longer sealed to the wall. Repair/replace the silicone seal so that the area is smooth and easily cleanable.

PHYSICAL FACILITIES shall be maintained in good repair.
